## Enhancements and bug fixes

For detailed information about the 8.6.0 release, review the enhancements and bug fixes.

### Enhancements

* Alerting

  * Clone rule [#144741](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/144741)
  * Remove errors and warning in triggers\_actions\_ui jest test [#144443](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/144443)
  * Increase the default table size of the cases table to 10 [#144228](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/144228)
  * Bulk enable rules api [#144216](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/144216)
  * Create bulk delete on rules front [#144101](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/144101)
  * Improve Task Manager’s retry logic for ad-hoc tasks [#143860](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/143860)
  * Increases the max length limit of the case title to 160 characters [#143664](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/143664)
  * Adds the ability to bulk edit tags in the cases table [#143450](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/143450)
  * Filter cases without assignees [#143390](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/143390)
  * Make actions retry when encountering failures [#143224](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/143224)
  * Adds a backlink to cases when pushing in external services [#143174](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/143174)
  * Move Connectors to own page [#142485](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/142485)
  * 142183 create bulk delete on rules [#142466](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/142466)
  * Allow `_source` field for ES DSL query rules [#142223](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/142223)
  * Update rule status [#140882](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/140882)

* APM

  * Adds pie charts displaying the most used mobile devices, operating systems, etc. [#144232](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/144232)
  * Adds the ability to filter mobile APM views [#144172](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/144172)
  * Adds average latency map to the mobile service overview [#144127](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/144127)
  * Adds new options to APM central configuration [#143668](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/143668)
  * Adds a trace waterfall to the dependency operation detail view [#143257](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/143257)
  * Adds a configuration table above code sample in getting started guide [#143178](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/143178)
  * Adds improvements to the AWS Lambda metrics view [#143113](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/143113)
  * Adds total APM size and perecent of disk space used to storage explorer [#143179](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/143179)
  * \[Technical preview] Adds the ability to display a critical path for a single trace [#143735](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/143735)
  * \[Technical preview] Adds the agent explorer inventory and detail page [#143844](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/143844)

* Dashboard

  * Adds unmapped runtime field support to options list [#144947](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/144947)
  * Adds "Exists" functionality to options list [#143762](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/143762)
  * Adds `excludes` toggle to options list [#142780](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/142780)
  * Adds support for IP field to options list [#142507](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/142507)
  * Adds option to disable cursor sync on dashboards [#143355](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/143355)

* Discover

  * Adds the ability to edit ad hoc data views without permissions [#142723](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/142723)
  * Enables `esQuery` alert for adhoc data views [#140885](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/140885)

* Elastic Security

  For the Elastic Security 8.6.0 release information, refer to [*Elastic Security Solution Release Notes*](/guide/en/security/8.18/release-notes.html).

* Enterprise Search

  For the Elastic Enterprise Search 8.6.0 release information, refer to [*Elastic Enterprise Search Documentation Release notes*](/guide/en/enterprise-search/8.18/changelog.html).

* Fleet

  Adds `?full` option to get package info endpoint to return all package fields [#144343](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/144343)

* Infrastructure

  * Use the Unified Search Bar for date range selection [#144351](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/144351)
  * Adds network traffic to Hosts table [#142137](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/142137)

* Kibana UI

  Updates the Dashboard, Visualize Library, and Maps pages with enhanced tag filtering [#142108](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/142108)

* Lens & Visualizations

  * Rearranges the options in **Lens** [#144891](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/144891)
  * Adds the ability to open **TSVB** tables in **Lens** [#143946](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/143946)
  * Adds advanced params to the formula API in **Lens** [#143876](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/143876)
  * Adds the ability to display value labels on histogram and stacked charts in **Lens** [#143635](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/143635)
  * Distinguishes the adhoc data views from the permanent data views in the dropdowns [#143525](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/143525)
  * Adds the ability to filter metrics in the **Lens** data table [#143219](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/143219)
  * Adds support for navigate Variance aggregations in **Lens** [#143209](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/143209)
  * Adds selected field accordion to the fields list in **Lens** [#143175](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/143175)
  * Adds the ability to open aggregation-based xy charts in **Lens** [#142936](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/142936)
  * Adds the ability to open aggregation-based Gauge and Goal visualizations in **Lens** [#142838](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/142838)
  * Enables cursor syncronization in **Lens** heatmaps [#142821](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/142821)
  * Adds a reduced time range option for formula in **Lens** [#142709](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/142709)
  * Adds the ability to open aggregation-based metric visualization in **Lens** [#142561](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/142561)
  * Adds the ability to edit data views in the **Lens** flyout [#142362](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/142362)
  * Adds conditional operations in the **Lens** formula [#142325](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/142325)
  * Adds the ability to explore fields in Discover from **Lens** [#142199](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/142199)
  * Adds the ability to open **TSVB** Gauge visualizations in **Lens** [#142187](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/142187)
  * Adds new defaults function in **Lens** [#142087](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/142087)
  * Adds support for mustache context variables with periods [#143703](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/143703)
  * Adds explore matching indices to data view menu [#141807](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/141807)
  * Adds control in the **Lens** annotations layer menu for global filters [#141615](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/141615)
  * Adds field filter to popover in **Lens** [#141582](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/141582)
  * Improves the performance for large formulas in **Lens** [#141456](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/141456)
  * Improves the Quick function in-product assistance in **Lens** [#141399](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/141399)
  * Adds bit formatter in **Lens** [#141372](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/141372)
  * Adds the ability to open aggregation-based pie visualizations in **Lens** [#140879](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/140879)
  * Adds the ability to open **TSVB** metric visualizations in **Lens** [#140878](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/140878)
  * Adds the ability to open aggregation-based table visualizations in **Lens** [#140791](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/140791)
  * Adds the ability to allow date functions in formula [#143632](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/143632)

* Machine Learning

  * Data Frame Analytics: Highlight filtered data in scatterplot charts [#144871](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/144871)
  * Allow updates for number of allocations and priority for trained model deployments [#144704](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/144704)
  * Switch from normal sampling to random sampler for Index data visualizer table [#144646](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/144646)
  * Explain Log Rate Spikes: Replace chunks of queries with concurrent queue [#144220](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/144220)
  * Explain Log Rate Spikes: Allow to continue failed stream [#143301](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/143301)
  * Entity filter for the Notifications page [#142778](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/142778)
  * Show an info callout for new notifications [#142245](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/142245)
  * Adding dashboard custom url to lens created jobs [#142139](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/142139)
  * Adds ML open API output to appendix [#141556](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/141556)

* Management

  Adds missing geo aggs to autocomplete in Console [#141504](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/141504)

* Maps

  * Adds the ability to invert color ramp and size [#143307](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/143307)
  * Adds layer groups [#142528](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/142528)
  * Adds the ability to hide or show all layers [#141495](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/141495)

* Observability

  * Adds kibana.alert.time\_range field to Alert-As-Data mappings and populate it [#141309](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/141309)
  * Alert summary widget new design [#141236](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/141236)
  * Adds histogram support for avg, max, min, sum and percentiles [#139770](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/139770)

* Platform

  Adds maxIdleSockets and idleSocketTimeout to Elasticsearch config [#142019](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/142019)

* Security

  * Adds a read-only mode to the User management screen for users with `read_security` cluster privilege [#143438](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/143438)
  * Adds a read-only mode to the API keys management screen for users with `read_security` cluster privilege [#144923](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/144923)
  * Adds `user.id` field to Kibana audit log [#141092](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/141092)

* Uptime

  * Allow using AND for tags filtering [#145079](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/145079)
  * Adds monitor detail flyout [#136156](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/136156)

### Bug fixes

* Alerting

  * Fixes logger text and fix bulk error type [#144598](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/144598)
  * Flaky bulkDisable tasks functional test [#144405](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/144405)
  * Adding back unknown outcome filter [#143546](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/143546)
  * Fixing flaky test in x-pack/test/functional\_with\_es\_ssl/apps/triggers\_actions\_ui/alerts\_list·ts [#142855](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/142855)
  * Rule run history displays success with a message when the rule status is warning [#142645](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/142645)
  * Elasticsearch query rule type allows SIZE: 0, but flags as error on re-edit [#142225](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/142225)
  * Rules and Connectors: Current page in breadcrumbs shows as link [#141838](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/141838)
  * Move save button into connector config form [#141361](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/141361)

* APM

  * Show a recommended minimum size when going below 5 minutes [#144170](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/144170)
  * Fixes ML permissions by removing usage of `canAccessML` [#143631](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/143631)
  * Fallback to terms aggregation search if terms enum doesn’t return results [#143619](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/143619)
  * Fixes bug that causes alert expression to not close [#143531](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/143531)
  * Fixes `apm.transaction_duration` alert to aggregrate over service environment [#143238](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/143238)
  * Fixes broken latency and services layout [#143453](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/143453)
  * Fixes metadata API environment filter [#144472](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/144472)

* Dashboard

  * The extra reload caused by Controls is now skipped [#142868](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/142868)
  * Modifies the state shared in dashboard permalinks [#141985](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/141985)

* Discover

  * Fixes theme for Alerts popover [#145390](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/145390)
  * Improves the no data views state for `esQuery` alert [#145052](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/145052)
  * Updates the data view id on adhoc data view change [#142069](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/142069)
  * Improves the error and fix app state when updating data view ID in the URL to an invalid ID [#141540](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/141540)

* Elastic Security

  For the Elastic Security 8.6.0 release information, refer to [*Elastic Security Solution Release Notes*](/guide/en/security/8.18/release-notes.html).

* Enterprise Search

  For the Elastic Enterprise Search 8.6.0 release information, refer to [*Elastic Enterprise Search Documentation Release notes*](/guide/en/enterprise-search/8.18/changelog.html).

* Fleet

  Only show fleet managed data streams on data streams list page [#143300](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/143300)

* Infrastructure

  Adds disk latency metrics to hosts table [#144312](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/144312)

* Kibana Home & Add Data

  * Updates the examples [#141265](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/141265)

* Lens & Visualizations

  * All saved queries are now returned on the list instead of only the first 50 [#145554](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/145554)
  * The baseTheme is now always included with the charts theme [#145401](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/145401)
  * Do not throw on undefined sorting column referenced in **Lens** [#144716](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/144716)
  * Fixes suggestion bug in **Lens** [#144708](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/144708)
  * The reference layer is now excluded from the cursor sync hook in **Lens** [#144384](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/144384)
  * Improves the embeddable warnings placement in **Lens** metric visualizations [#144368](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/144368)
  * Fixes the list control popover background color in dark mode [#144204](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/144204)
  * The unused dimension label from the tooltip in **Lens** is now hidden [#143721](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/143721)
  * Improves the default text for the controls options list [#143413](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/143413)
  * Fixes styling issues in **Vega** [#143168](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/143168)
  * Fixes an issue where the shard failure notices made **Lens** unusable [#142985](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/142985)
  * Fixes the syncing for colors and tooltips [#142957](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/142957)
  * Updates the label for Time field annotations in **TSVB** [#142452](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/142452)
  * Fixes an issue where empty annotation query strings in **TSVB** and **Lens** displayed different results [#142197](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/142197)
  * Drag and drop capabilities of a single element in **Lens** is no longer allowed [#141793](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/141793)
  * Fixes the ability to close the settings popover with a click in **Lens** [#141272](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/141272)

* Machine Learning

  * Fixes the default time range on the Notifications page [#145578](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/145578)
  * Data Frame Analytics maps view: ensure nodes reload correctly after using timepicker refresh [#145265](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/145265)
  * Explain Log Rate Spikes: Fix applying overall params to histogram queries [#144219](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/144219)
  * Calculate model memory limit for Lens created jobs [#143456](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/143456)
  * Explain Log Rate Spikes: fix chart showing as empty when filter matches field/value pair in hovered row [#142693](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/142693)

* Management

  * Fixes nested formatter for terms [#144543](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/144543)
  * Cache ad-hoc data views to avoid repeated field list calls [#144465](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/144465)
  * In the case of 2 or more panels on the dashboard, TSVB renderComplete fires 2 times [#143999](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/143999)
  * Shard failure notifications have been reduced when many queries fail at the same time [#131776](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/131776)

* Maps

  * Fixes an issue where the Time Slider text was not working properly with Dark Mode [#145612](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/145612)
  * Adds ungroup layers action [#144574](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/144574)

* Observability

  Fixes alerts' blank page in case of invalid query string [#145067](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/145067)

* Observability Home

  * Use bucketSize from request options for overview query [#145032](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/145032)
  * Solution nav with no data page [#144280](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/144280)

* Querying & Filtering

  * Fixes an issue with autocomplete value suggestions where the date range was sometimes incorrectly applied [#144134](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/144134)
  * Fixes Moment.js timezone error when defining a range filter [#143213](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/143213)

* Reporting

  * Fixed a bug with CSV export in Discover, where searching over hundreds of shards would result in an incomplete CSV file [#144201](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/144201)
  * Fixes an issue where downloading a report caused a new browser tab to open with the report content, rather than receiving a downloaded file [#144136](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/144136)
  * Fixed an issue with CSV exports from Discover, where using the `_id` field in an export, when `_id` is a very high numeric value, the value could lose precision [#143807](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/143807)

## Enhancements and bug fixes

For detailed information about the 8.4.0 release, review the enhancements and bug fixes.

### Enhancements

* Alerting

  * Adds snooze state UI to Rule Details page [#135146](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/135146)
  * Adds Snooze Scheduling UI and API [#134512](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/134512)
  * Adds recovery context for ES query rule type [#132839](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/132839)
  * Visualize alerting metrics in Stack Monitoring [#123726](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/123726)

* Canvas

  * Markdown element auto-applies text changes [#133318](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/133318)
  * Lines operations keybindings [#132914](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/132914)
  * Detailed tooltip [#131116](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/131116)

* Cases

  * Improved the cases search bar functionality. The search functionality will only consider the title and description fields [#136776](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/136776)
  * Performance improvements were made to reduce the time required to create, update, and delete cases and comments. In our testing we saw around a half second reduction in the round trip time for the UI requests [#136452](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/136452)

* Dashboard

  Hide controls callout when the `hideAnnouncements` setting is `true` [#136410](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/136410)

* Design

  * Adds an H1 tag with the workpad title when viewing workpads [#135504](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/135504)
  * Improve keyboard navigation in Discover top nav menu [#134788](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/134788)

* Discover

  * Improves the HTML formatting of fields with a list of values [#136684](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/136684)
  * Adds support for accessing the edit field flyout from the document explorer column popover [#135277](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/135277)
  * Adds support for copying the query from the add rule flyout [#135098](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/135098)
  * Adds focus to h1 on navigate for single document and surrounding document views [#134942](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/134942)
  * Improves the creation and editing of "Elasticsearch query" rule in Management [#134763](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/134763)
  * Adds data view changed warning after alert rule created [#134674](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/134674)
  * Make *Test query* button pretty [#134605](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/134605)
  * Improves the document explorer timestamp tooltip accessibility [#134411](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/134411)
  * Adds focus to h1 element when client side routing is executed [#133846](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/133846)
  * Adds an option to copy column values to Clipboard in Document Explorer [#132330](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/132330)

  For the Elastic Security 8.4.0 release information, refer to [*Elastic Security Solution Release Notes*](/guide/en/security/8.18/release-notes.html).

  * Remove Kubernetes Package granularity [#136622](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/136622)
  * Elastic-agent manifests: align with elastic-agent repo; add comments [#136394](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/136394)

  * That PR will enable user to write custom ingest pipeline for Fleet installed datastream [#134578](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/134578)
  * Update manifests for agent on kubernetes with new permissions [#133495](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/133495)
  * Adds support for a textarea type in integrations [#133070](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/133070)

* Kibana Home & Add Data

  Adds AnalyticsNoDataPage [#134172](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/134172)

* Lens & Visualizations

  * Adds supports for include and exclude terms in **Lens** [#136179](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/136179)
  * Adds the ability to set top values limit to 10,000 in **Lens** [#136399](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/136399)
  * Addss value count to **Lens** [#136385](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/136385)
  * Adds standard deviation function in **Lens** [#136323](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/136323)
  * Adds the ability to set the font size for mosaic outer level in **Lens** [#135911](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/135911)
  * Adds the ability to rank top values by custom metric in **Lens** [#134811](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/134811)

  * Adds the ability to allow multiple split accessors [#134566](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/134566)
